content.name: Olivia MacPherson
content.title: Business Analyst
content.summary: CCBA-certified business analyst with nine years in oilfield supply, insurance and group benefits. Lead analysis for a benefits co-op's claims portal rebuild, where the new self-serve flow removed about 30% of inbound calls. Practical, detail-focused and comfortable moving between process maps, SQL queries and user acceptance testing.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Lead business analysis for the member claims portal rebuild, coordinating requirements across claims, member services and two vendor teams.
Designed a self-serve claim status flow that removed about 30% of inbound calls to the contact centre within four months.
Wrote data mapping specifications for migrating 1.1 million historical claims, with reconciliations signed off by finance.
Coach two newer analysts on story writing and facilitation.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Captured requirements for a broker portal used by 300 brokerages, raising online submissions from 40% to 72% of new business.
Ran root-cause analysis on policy issuance errors and specified validation rules that halved rework.
Planned and led UAT for four releases, triaging 380 defects with the QA lead.

experience.title: Junior Business Analyst
bullets: Documented order-to-cash processes across six branches ahead of an ERP upgrade.
Built SQL reports on backorders that helped purchasing reduce stockouts of fast-moving parts by 20%.
Trained 35 branch staff on new quoting screens during the upgrade.

education.degree: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), General Management

courses.name: Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA)

achievements.title: Service excellence award
achievements.detail: Glenmore Health Benefits Co-op team award (2024) for the claims portal launch.

achievements.title: Volunteer board member
achievements.detail: Treasurer for a Calgary community association, managing an annual budget of about $90,000.
